items.summary: Recommendation: continue the existing bounded, reversible measurement and evidence work, with no duplicate queue tasks. The 30-day SEO window through 2026-09-23 recorded 13,177 impressions, 126 clicks, 932 sessions, and 13 conversions; Amazon reported $4.92 commission on 2026-09-21 from 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, and 6 shipped items. Site-level margin and ROI are not calculable because one tracking ID is unmapped and direct costs are unavailable. The main unknown is which sites can produce attributable contribution margin without disproportionate build or renewal cost. Smallest next step: complete the active evidence and measurement gates for at least three sites, then measure deployed changes after 14 days or 100 new impressions. Owner question: for SearchWoot choose A) keep private, B) approve preparation of an unsent Woot permission request, or C) end the public-beta pursuit.
